text:
jules: Heads up — onboarding quickstart behaves poorly under sustained mixed load. Observed pattern: steady -> ~2s stall -> simultaneous page fetches. Repro: ./scripts/load --clients=48 --pages=8 --mix search:heavy,embed:heavy

maria: Which SDK + sampleapp? Any logs to paste?

jules: js-sdk@0.12.0, sampleapp main. Snippet:
```
WARN limiter: queued (scope=global) inflight=200
DEBUG paginator: holding cursor page=5 waiting permit
INFO auth: started refresh (caller=worker-13)
INFO retry: attempt=1 bypass_limiter=true
ERROR api: 403 invalid_token_transient
```

vik: bypass_limiter=true again. Our retry path fast-tracks to reduce latency but it creates bursts when refreshes are slow.

elaine: SDK parity note: Go samples use route-scoped semaphores by default. JS has global leaky-bucket. That cross-route sharing can cause embed requests to starve paginators.

jules: Short-term workaround: run sampleapp with MULTI_CLIENT=true to allocate a client per logical route. Mitigates immediately for demos.

maria: Long-term fixes proposed:
- add limiter.scope config (global|client|route) default global for compat
- ensure all retry/auth paths call limiter.acquire() (remove bypass)
- add auth singleflight in js-sdk (promise cache)
- make paginator prefetch next-page async (PREFETCH_NEXT=true) to avoid holding cursor while waiting for permit

vik: Singleflight impl idea: Map<key,Promise>. On refresh start set promise; subsequent refresh await same promise. On resolve or reject, delete key. Add small TTL < token TTL to avoid refresh storms. Unit tests: simulate 10 concurrent callers and assert only 1 refresh call is made.

elaine: Also add jittered retry backoff even after refresh resolves, to avoid N clients re-sending at same tick. Emit telemetry: limiter.scope, auth.refresh.concurrent, paginator.hold_ms.

jules: CI: add e2e job devex/load-e2e that runs mixed load for 90s and asserts p95 < 600ms and <3s max stall, and no auth 5xx spike. PRs should be behind feature flags and rolled to canary.

maria: I'll own auth singleflight + tests. Vik you take limiter.scope change. Elaine update paginator + telemetry.

ci-bot: Please file issue area/devex, add labels test/e2e and priority/medium. Include load commands and sampleapp flags in issue body.

jules: Opening draft PR branch feat/devex/route-scope-js and will link in the issue. Posting repro artifacts and a minimal load script. :thumbsup:
